notes.title: PATCH III: 21:9 & Multi-Monitor Support!
notes.content:
Ultra wide screen, Multi-monitor and aspect ratio adjustment support. FOV changes to match the resolution to give the same impression as if playing on a standard 16:9 screen, up to a maximum viewing angle of 180 degrees.

It. Is. Awesome.

Sincerely,
The ULTRA ULTRA team

notes.title: PATCH TWO: RAZER
notes.content:
ECHO now supports Razer Chroma peripherals: Experience the blackouts across all your Chroma peripherals! Palace ambience color corresponding to which section you are in, as well as active keys, hurt sphere, stamina- and recharging-bar. It’s cool!

Also, now you can re-watch cut-scenes and Verses from the Level Select Menu. (Cut-scene “seen” status for being able to skip should now save properly as well!)

Window mode, resolution and aspect ratio now only gets applied when user presses an Apply-button instead of applying while changing values in the menu, which sucked.

And, of course, minor bug fixes and visual updates.

Merry Christmas!

notes.title: Patch ONE!
notes.content:
We fixed a bunch of stuff:

- Unlocks not unlocking fixed. This will also unlock them for people who already should have gotten them.

- Fixed the Six Thrones Problem.

- Fixed issue where some keys on the keyboard were not bindable

- Extendable bridge teleportation fix.

- Fix for Key Waypoints activating too early under certain circumstances

- Fixed player camera getting stuck sometimes.

- UI and text tweaks.

- Visual updates and minor gameplay bug fixes/tweaks here and there.

- Steam Cloud enabled.

Thanks for playing!

Sincerely,

Ultra Ultra

notes.title: Missing Achievements HOTFIX is up!
notes.content:
Achievements now work again!

The bad news is that the achievements (not) gotten between this Hotfix and the last, will have to be gotten again... Really sorry about that. In our rush to fix the Rapunzel problem it seems we accidentally left some important Steam components behind.

Other smaller fixes include not falling out of world and not getting stuck, which is more fun than falling out of world and getting stuck!

Sincerely,

ULTRA ULTRA
